foliiProtectie.title: Protective films | Adin Prod
foliiProtectie.description: Polyethylene protective films with acrylic adhesive for pre-painted sheet metal, stainless steel, aluminium, carpet, glass and polycarbonate. They peel off without adhesive residue.

foliiStretch.title: Stretch film | Adin Prod
foliiStretch.description: Clear or black stretch film, 125 – 500 mm, 17 – 23 mic, for manual or automatic wrapping, with loads of up to 1000 kg per pallet.

benziAdezive.title: Adhesive tapes | Adin Prod
benziAdezive.description: BOPP adhesive tapes with acrylic, natural rubber or hot melt adhesive, for plastic, paper, cardboard, metal, glass and wood.

intro.title: Protection solutions for industry and packaging
intro.text: We import and distribute protective films, stretch films and adhesive tapes. We protect surfaces during production, storage, transport and installation, and our products can be tailored to each customer.

about.title: About us
about.p1: SC ADIN PROD INTERNATIONAL SRL is an importer and distributor of protective films, stretch films and self-adhesive tapes. The experience we have gained over the years allows us to offer customers personalised products, tailored to their needs.
about.p2: We offer competitive prices and prompt delivery. Products are delivered from our warehouse in Bucharest or directly from our suppliers’ warehouses, on order.
about.p3: Our customers are our business partners. Every day we strive to earn and keep their trust through the products we supply.
